== Biography ==
'''Jean Mitchell''' lived at Torryburn, Fife, where the parish register names her as the mother of 1 child baptised there. Their father was [[Glasgow-4176|James Glasgow]], named in the same entry.

* [[Glasgow-4125|John Glasgow]], baptised 15 Oct 1689

No record of Jean's own birth, parents or death has been found. Her birth is placed before 1670, the year by which she must have been born to be old enough to mother John in 1689; Torryburn is inferred from her children's baptisms.<ref name="OPR">Findmypast, ''Scotland, Parish Births & Baptisms 1564–1929'', Torryburn, Fife, Old Parish Register; the individual baptism entries are cited on each child's profile, for example [https://www.findmypast.co.uk/transcript?id=SCOT%2FOPR%2FBAP%2F2618062&tab=this John Glasgow, 15 Oct 1689].</ref>

== Research Notes ==
Jean and James Glasgow are linked only by the recurring parent names in the Torryburn register. No record of her own parents, birth or death has been found.

The named parent–child relationships concern the people in this one baptism entry. No record of James or Jean’s own parents, or John’s later life, has been identified. The before-1670 parent dates are estimates from an assumed adult generation, not ages stated in the baptism. The transcript remains to be checked against the original register.
